units.zh: 二月，沛公從碭北攻昌邑，遇彭越。
units.en: In the second month, Pei Gong from north of Dang attacked Changyi and encountered Peng Yue.
units.literal: Second month, Pei Gong from north of Dang attacked Changyi, encountered Peng Yue.

units.zh: 沛公西過高陽，酈食其為里監門，曰：「諸將過此者多，吾視沛公大度。」
units.en: Pei Gong passed west through Gaoyang. Li Yiji was the village gatekeeper and said: "Many generals have passed through here. I can see that Pei Gong has great magnanimity."
units.literal: Pei Gong west passed Gaoyang, Li Yiji was village gatekeeper, said: 'Various generals who passed this place many, I observe Pei Gong has great magnanimity.'

units.zh: 乃求見沛公。
units.en: So he sought to see Pei Gong.
units.literal: Then requested to see Pei Gong.

units.zh: 沛公方踞床，使兩女子洗。
units.en: Pei Gong was sitting cross-legged on a bed, having two women wash his feet.
units.literal: Pei Gong just then squatting on bed, made two women wash.

units.zh: 於是沛公起，攝衣謝之，延上坐。
units.en: So Pei Gong rose, straightened his clothes, and apologized. He invited him to sit in the honored position.
units.literal: Thereupon Pei Gong rose, gathered clothes thanked him, invited to upper seat.

units.zh: 食其說沛公襲陳留。
units.en: Yiji persuaded Pei Gong to attack Chenliu by surprise.
units.literal: Yiji persuaded Pei Gong to attack Chenliu by surprise.

units.zh: 沛公以為廣野君，以其弟商為將，將陳留兵。
units.en: Pei Gong made him Lord Guangye and appointed his younger brother Shang as general, commanding the Chenliu troops.
units.literal: Pei Gong made him Lord Guangye and appointed his younger brother Shang as general, commanding the Chenliu troops.

units.zh: 時趙別將司馬卬方欲渡河入關，沛公乃北攻平陰，絕河津。
units.en: At this time, Sima Ang, a separate Zhao general, was about to cross the Yellow River and enter the passes. Pei Gong therefore attacked Pingyin to the north and cut off the river crossings.
units.literal: At this time, the Zhao general Sima Ang was about to cross the river into the passes. Pei Gong attacked Beiyin to the north and cut off the river crossings.

units.zh: 沛公引兵過宛西。
units.en: Pei Gong led his troops west past Wan.
units.literal: Pei Gong led his troops west past Wan.

units.zh: 張良諫曰：「沛公雖欲急入關，秦兵尚眾，距險。
units.en: Zhang Liang advised: "Although Pei Gong wishes to rush into the passes, the Qin troops are still numerous and hold the dangerous passes.
units.literal: Zhang Liang advised: "Although Pei Gong wishes to rush into the passes, the Qin troops are still numerous and hold the dangerous passes.

units.zh: 沛公至霸上。
units.en: The Duke of Pei reached Bashang.
units.literal: The Duke of Pei reached Bashang.

units.zh: 諸將或言誅秦王，沛公曰：「始懷王遣我，固以能寬容，且人已服降，殺之不祥。」
units.en: Some of the generals said that the King of Qin should be executed. The Duke of Pei said, "When King Huai first sent me, it was precisely because I was able to be lenient. Moreover, the man has already submitted and surrendered; to kill him would be inauspicious."
units.literal: Some of the generals said to execute the King of Qin. The Duke of Pei said, "When King Huai first sent me, it was precisely because I was able to be lenient; moreover, the man has already submitted and surrendered, and to kill him would be inauspicious."

units.zh: 三月，漢王自臨晉渡河，魏王豹降，將兵從。
units.en: In the third month, King Han crossed the Yellow River from Linjin. King Wei Bao surrendered and led troops to follow him.
units.literal: In the third month, King Han crossed the Yellow River from Linjin. King Wei Bao surrendered and led troops to follow him.

units.zh: 南渡平陰津，至洛陽，新城三老董公遮說漢王曰：「臣聞『順德者昌，逆德者亡』，『兵出無名，事故不成』。
units.en: He crossed south at Pingyin Ford and reached Luoyang. Dong Gong, the elder of Xincheng, stopped the King of Han and advised him: "I have heard, 'Those who follow virtue prosper; those who oppose virtue perish,' and, 'When troops are sent out without a proper name, the enterprise will not succeed.'
units.literal: He crossed south at Pingyin ford and reached Luoyang. The elder of Xincheng, Dong Gong, blocked and advised King Han: "I have heard that 'those who follow virtue prosper, those who oppose virtue perish,' and 'when troops are sent out without just cause, affairs will not succeed.'

units.zh: 羽見紀信，問：「漢王安在？」
units.en: Xiang Yu saw Ji Xin and asked: "Where is King Han?"
units.literal: Xiang Yu saw Ji Xin and asked: "Where is King Han?"

units.zh: 漢王從之。
units.en: King Han followed their advice.
units.literal: King Han followed their advice.

units.zh: 吾與諸侯約，先入關者王之，吾當王關中。
units.en: I made an agreement with the feudal lords: whoever first entered the Pass would be king there, and I should be king in Guanzhong.
units.literal: I made an agreement with the feudal lords: whoever first entered the Pass would be king there, and I should be king in Guanzhong.

units.zh: 民又益喜，唯恐沛公不為秦王。
units.en: The people were even more delighted and feared only that the Duke of Pei would not become King of Qin.
units.literal: The people were even more delighted and feared only that the Duke of Pei would not become King of Qin.

units.zh: 背約，更立沛公為漢王，王巴、蜀、漢中四十一縣，都南鄭。
units.en: Breaking the agreement, he further established Pei Gong as King of Han, ruling Ba, Shu, Hanzhong, and 41 counties, with capital at Nanzheng.
units.literal: Breaking the agreement, he further established Pei Gong as King of Han, ruling Ba, Shu, Hanzhong, and 41 counties, with capital at Nanzheng.

units.zh: 漢王怨羽之背約，欲攻之，丞相蕭何諫，乃止。
units.en: King Han resented Xiang Yu for breaking the agreement and wanted to attack him. Chancellor Xiao He advised against it, so he stopped.
units.literal: King Han resented Xiang Yu for breaking the agreement and wanted to attack him. Chancellor Xiao He advised against it, so he stopped.

units.zh: 漢王曰：「善，非夫子無所聞。」
units.en: King Han said: "Excellent. Were it not for you, sir, I would have heard nothing of this."
units.literal: King Han said: "Excellent. Were it not for you, sir, I would have heard nothing of this."

units.zh: 及壯，試吏，為泗上亭長，廷中吏無所不狎侮。
units.en: When he reached adulthood, he tried serving as an official and became pavilion chief of Sishang. Among the officials at court there was none he did not treat with familiar disrespect.
units.literal: When he reached adulthood, he tried serving as an official, became the pavilion chief of Sishang, and among the officials in the court there was none he did not treat with familiarity and insult.

units.zh: 沛公然其計，從之。
units.en: Pei Gong approved this plan and followed it.
units.literal: Pei Gong approved this plan and followed it.

units.zh: 五月，漢王引兵從故道出襲雍。
units.en: In the fifth month, King Han led troops from the old road to attack Yong by surprise.
units.literal: In the fifth month, King Han led troops from the old road to attack Yong by surprise.

units.zh: 漢王出滎陽，至成皋。
units.en: King Han left Xingyang and reached Chenggao.
units.literal: King Han left Xingyang and reached Chenggao.

units.zh: 母媼嘗息大澤之陂，夢與神遇。
units.en: Once, while resting by the dike of a vast marsh, his mother dreamed that she encountered a divine being.
units.literal: His mother the old woman once rested by the dike of the great marsh, and dreamed of encountering a god.

units.zh: 是時雷電晦冥，父太公往視，則見交龍於上。
units.en: At that moment, thunder crashed and darkness fell. His father, Taigong, went to investigate and saw two dragons entwined in the sky above.
units.literal: At this time thunder and lightning were dark and obscure, father Taigong went to look, then saw two dragons entwining above.

units.zh: 呂公女即呂后也，生孝惠帝、魯元公主。
units.en: This daughter of Lü Gong would become Empress Lü. She gave birth to Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan.
units.literal: Lü Gong's daughter was namely Empress Lü, gave birth to Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan.

units.zh: 呂后與兩子居田中，有一老父過請飲，呂后因餔之。
units.en: Empress Lü lived in the countryside with their two children. An old man passed by and asked for a drink. Empress Lü fed him.
units.literal: Empress Lü and the two children resided in the fields, there was an old father who passed by requesting drink, Empress Lü because of this fed him.

units.zh: 竟酒，後。
units.en: When the wine was finished, Gaozu stayed behind.
units.literal: The wine banquet ended, afterwards.

units.zh: 嫗曰：「吾子，白帝子也，化為蛇，當道，今者赤帝子斬之，故哭。」
units.en: The old woman said: "My son was the son of the White Emperor. He transformed into a snake and blocked the road. Just now, the son of the Red Emperor cut him down. That's why I'm crying."
units.literal: Old woman said: 'My son was the son of the White Emperor, transformed into a snake, blocked the path, now the son of the Red Emperor cut him, therefore cry.'

units.zh: 幟皆赤，由所殺蛇白帝子，所殺者赤帝子故也。
units.en: All the banners were red, because the snake he killed was the son of the White Emperor, and the one who killed it was the son of the Red Emperor.
units.literal: The banners all red, because the killed snake was White Emperor's son, the one who killed was Red Emperor's son therefore.

units.zh: 於是沛公乃夜引軍從他道還，偃旗幟，遲明，圍宛城三匝。
units.en: So Pei Gong led his army back by another route at night, hid his banners, and at dawn surrounded Wan city three times.
units.literal: So Pei Gong led his army back by another route at night, hid his banners, and at dawn surrounded Wan city three times.

units.zh: 乃踰城見沛公，曰：「臣聞足下約先入咸陽者王之，今足下留守宛。
units.en: He therefore climbed over the wall to meet Pei Gong and said, "I have heard that you agreed that whoever first entered Xianyang would be made king there. Now you are staying here to besiege Wan.
units.literal: So he climbed over the wall to see Pei Gong and said: "I have heard that you promised to enfeoff as king whoever first entered Xianyang. Now you remain besieging Wan.

units.zh: 沛公曰：「善。」
units.en: Pei Gong said: "Excellent."
units.literal: Pei Gong said: "Excellent."

units.zh: 八月，沛公攻武關，入秦。
units.en: In the eighth month, Pei Gong attacked Wuguan and entered Qin.
units.literal: In the eighth month, Pei Gong attacked Wuguan and entered Qin.

units.zh: 秦相趙高恐，乃殺二世，使人來，欲約分王關中，沛公不許。
units.en: The Qin Chancellor Zhao Gao became afraid, so he killed the Second Emperor and sent men to propose dividing Guanzhong into kingdoms. Pei Gong refused.
units.literal: Qin chancellor Zhao Gao became fearful, so he killed the Second Emperor and sent people to try to make a treaty to divide the kingship of Guanzhong. Pei Gong did not agree.

units.zh: 沛公欲擊之，張良曰：「秦兵尚彊，未可輕。
units.en: Pei Gong wanted to attack them. Zhang Liang said: "The Qin troops are still strong. We cannot be careless.
units.literal: Pei Gong wanted to attack them. Zhang Liang said: "The Qin troops are still strong. We cannot be careless.

units.zh: 秦將果欲連和，沛公欲許之。
units.en: The Qin general indeed wanted to form an alliance. Pei Gong wanted to agree.
units.literal: The Qin general indeed wanted to form an alliance. Pei Gong wanted to agree.

units.zh: 沛公引兵繞嶢關，踰蕢山，擊秦軍，大破之藍田南。
units.en: Pei Gong led his troops around Yao Pass, crossed Mount Qi, attacked the Qin army, and greatly defeated them south of Lantian.
units.literal: Pei Gong led his troops around Yao Pass, crossed Mount Qi, attacked the Qin army, and greatly defeated them south of Lantian.

units.zh: 沛公讓不受，曰：「倉粟多，不欲費民。」
units.en: The Duke of Pei declined and would not accept them, saying, "There is abundant grain in the granaries, and I do not want to burden the people."
units.literal: The Duke of Pei declined and would not accept them, saying, "There is much grain in the granaries, and I do not wish to burden the people."

units.zh: 或說沛公曰：「秦富十倍天下，地形彊。
units.en: Someone advised Pei Gong: "Qin is ten times as wealthy as all the rest of the realm, and its terrain is strong.
units.literal: Someone advised Pei Gong: "Qin is ten times richer than the world, and its terrain is strong.

units.zh: 即來，沛公恐不得有此。
units.en: If he comes, you may not be able to keep this.
units.literal: If he comes, Pei Gong fears he may not be able to hold this.

units.zh: 聞沛公已定關中，羽大怒，使黥布等攻破函谷關，遂至戲下。
units.en: When he heard that Pei Gong had already pacified Guanzhong, Xiang Yu was furious and sent Ying Bu and others to break through Hangu Pass, then advanced to Xi.
units.literal: He heard that Pei Gong had already pacified Guanzhong. Xiang Yu was greatly angered and sent Ying Bu and others to break through Hangu Pass, then reached Xixia.

units.zh: 沛公左司馬曹毋傷聞羽怒，欲攻沛公，使人言羽曰：「沛公欲王關中，令子嬰相，珍寶盡有之。」
units.en: Cao Wushang, Pei Gong's Left Marshal, heard that Xiang Yu was angry and wanted to attack Pei Gong. He sent someone to tell Xiang Yu, "Pei Gong wants to become king of Guanzhong, make Zi Ying his chancellor, and keep all the precious treasures."
units.literal: Pei Gong's left marshal Cao Wushang heard of Xiang Yu's anger and wanted to attack Pei Gong. He sent someone to tell Xiang Yu: "Pei Gong wants to become king of Guanzhong and has Zi Ying as chancellor, possessing all the precious treasures."

units.zh: 亞父范增說羽曰：「沛公居山東時，貪財好色，今聞其入關，珍物無所取，婦女無所幸，此其志不小。
units.en: Fan Zeng, the Second Father, advised Xiang Yu: "When Pei Gong was east of the mountains, he was greedy for wealth and fond of women. Now we hear that after entering the passes, he has taken no precious objects and favored no women. His ambitions are not small.
units.literal: Prime Minister Fan Zeng advised Xiang Yu: "When Pei Gong was in Shandong, he was greedy for wealth and fond of women. Now we hear that upon entering the passes, he has taken none of the precious objects and favored none of the women. His ambitions are not small.

units.zh: 沛公兵十萬，號二十萬，力不敵。
units.en: Pei Gong's troops numbered 100,000, claiming 200,000. Their strength was no match.
units.literal: Pei Gong's troops numbered 100,000, claiming 200,000. Their strength was no match.

units.zh: 良曰：「臣為韓王送沛公，不可不告，亡去不義。」
units.en: Liang said, "The King of Han sent me to escort Pei Gong. I cannot fail to inform him; to flee would be unrighteous."
units.literal: Liang said: "I was sent by the King of Han to escort Pei Gong. I cannot fail to inform him. To flee would be unrighteous."

units.zh: 乃與項伯俱見沛公。
units.en: So he went with Xiang Bo to see Pei Gong.
units.literal: So he went with Xiang Bo to see Pei Gong.

units.zh: 沛公與伯約為婚姻，曰：「吾入關，秋豪無所敢取，籍吏民，封府庫，待將軍。
units.en: Pei Gong formed a marriage alliance with Xiang Bo and said: "When I entered the passes, I dared not take even the smallest thing. I registered the officials and people, sealed the storehouses and treasuries, and waited for the general.
units.literal: Pei Gong made a marriage alliance with Xiang Bo and said: "When I entered the passes, I dared not take even the smallest thing. I registered the officials and people, sealed the treasuries, and waited for the general.

units.zh: 戒沛公曰：「旦日不可不早自來謝。」
units.en: Xiang Bo warned Pei Gong: "Tomorrow you must come early to apologize."
units.literal: He warned Pei Gong: "Tomorrow morning you must not fail to come early and apologize."

units.zh: 項伯還，具以沛公言告羽，因曰：「沛公不先破關中兵，公巨能入乎？
units.en: Xiang Bo returned and told Xiang Yu everything Pei Gong had said, then added, "If Pei Gong had not first defeated the Guanzhong troops, could you have entered?
units.literal: Xiang Bo returned and told Xiang Yu everything Pei Gong had said. He added: "If Pei Gong had not first broken the Guanzhong troops, could you have entered?

units.zh: 沛公旦日從百餘騎見羽鴻門，謝曰：「臣與將軍戮力攻秦，將軍戰河北，臣戰河南，不自意先入關，能破秦，與將軍復相見。
units.en: The next morning, Pei Gong came with more than a hundred riders to see Xiang Yu at Hongmen and apologized: "I joined forces with the general to attack Qin. The general fought north of the Yellow River, and I fought south of it. I did not expect to enter the passes first, defeat Qin, and then meet the general again.
units.literal: The next morning Pei Gong came with over a hundred cavalry to see Xiang Yu at Hongmen. He apologized: "I and the general joined forces to attack Qin. The general fought north of the Yellow River, I fought south of the Yellow River. I did not expect to enter the passes first and break Qin, then meet the general again.

units.zh: 羽曰：「此沛公左司馬曹毋傷言之，不然，籍何以生此？」
units.en: Xiang Yu said: "This was reported by Pei Gong's left marshal Cao Wushang. Otherwise, how could such suspicions have arisen?"
units.literal: Xiang Yu said: "This was spoken by Pei Gong's left marshal Cao Wushang. Otherwise, how could I have thought this?"

units.zh: 羽因留沛公飲。
units.en: Xiang Yu then kept Pei Gong to drink.
units.literal: Xiang Yu then kept Pei Gong to drink.

units.zh: 范增數目羽擊沛公，羽不應。
units.en: Fan Zeng repeatedly signaled Xiang Yu to attack Pei Gong, but Xiang Yu did not respond.
units.literal: Fan Zeng repeatedly signaled Xiang Yu to attack Pei Gong, but Xiang Yu did not respond.

units.zh: 君王為人不忍，汝入以劍舞，因擊沛公，殺之。
units.en: Our lord is too softhearted. Go in and perform a sword dance, then strike Pei Gong and kill him.
units.literal: The lord is a man without mercy. You enter and perform the sword dance, then take advantage to strike Pei Gong and kill him.

units.zh: 項伯亦起舞，常以身翼蔽沛公。
units.en: Xiang Bo also rose to dance, constantly using his body to shield Pei Gong.
units.literal: Xiang Bo also rose to dance, constantly using his body to shield Pei Gong.

units.zh: 有頃，沛公起如廁，招樊噲出，置車官屬，獨騎，與樊噲、靳彊、滕公、紀成步，從間道走軍，使張良留謝羽。
units.en: After a while, Pei Gong rose as if to use the privy and beckoned Fan Kuai out. Leaving his carriages and attendants behind, he rode off alone, while Fan Kuai, Jin Qiang, Lord Teng, and Ji Cheng went on foot. They fled the camp by a side road, and he had Zhang Liang remain to apologize to Xiang Yu.
units.literal: After a while, Pei Gong rose as if to use the toilet and beckoned Fan Kuai to come out. He placed his chariot officials and retainers, rode alone with Fan Kuai, Jin Qiang, Lord Teng, and Ji Cheng on foot, escaping the army by a side road, leaving Zhang Liang to stay and apologize to Xiang Yu.

units.zh: 羽問：「沛公安在？」
units.en: Xiang Yu asked: "Where is Pei Gong?"
units.literal: Xiang Yu asked: "Where is Pei Gong?"

units.zh: 增怒，撞其斗，起曰：「吾屬今為沛公虜矣！」
units.en: Fan Zeng was angry and smashed his goblet. He rose and said: "We and our clans will soon be Pei Gong's captives!"
units.literal: Fan Zeng was angry and smashed his goblet. He rose and said: "We and our clans will soon be Pei Gong's captives!"

units.zh: 沛公歸數日，羽引兵西屠咸陽，殺秦降王子嬰，燒秦宮室，所過無不殘滅。
units.en: Several days after Pei Gong returned, Xiang Yu led his troops west, slaughtered Xianyang, killed Zi Ying, the surrendered prince of Qin, and burned the Qin palaces. Wherever he passed, everything was devastated.
units.literal: Pei Gong returned several days later. Xiang Yu led troops west to massacre Xianyang, killed the Qin surrender prince Zi Ying, burned the Qin palaces. Everywhere he passed, nothing was left undestroyed.

units.zh: 羽怨懷王不肯令與沛公俱西入關，而北救趙，後天下約。
units.en: Xiang Yu resented King Huai for refusing to let him enter the passes westward together with Pei Gong, instead sending him north to rescue Zhao, so that he came too late for the agreement over the realm.
units.literal: Xiang Yu resented that King Huai had not allowed him to enter the passes together with Pei Gong, but instead had him go north to rescue Zhao, coming after the agreement about the world.

units.zh: 羽使卒三萬人從漢王，楚子、諸侯人之慕從者數萬人，從杜南入蝕中。
units.en: Xiang Yu sent thirty thousand soldiers to accompany the King of Han, and several tens of thousands of Chu nobles and men from the feudal lords admired him and followed as well. They entered Shuzhong from south of Du.
units.literal: Xiang Yu sent 30,000 troops to follow King Han, and Chu nobles and feudal lords who admired and followed him numbered several tens of thousands. They entered Shuzhong from Dushan.

units.zh: 張良辭歸韓，漢王送至褒中，因說漢王燒絕棧道，以備諸侯盜兵，亦視項羽無東意。
units.en: Zhang Liang took leave to return to Han. The King of Han escorted him as far as Baozhong, and there Zhang Liang advised him to burn and sever the plank roads, both to guard against raiding troops from the feudal lords and to show Xiang Yu that he had no intention of going east.
units.literal: Zhang Liang took leave to return to Han. King Han escorted him to Baozhong, where Zhang Liang advised King Han to burn and destroy the plank roads to guard against bandit troops of the feudal lords, and also to show Xiang Yu that he had no intention of going east.

units.zh: 漢王既至南鄭，諸將及士卒皆歌謳思東歸，多道亡還者。
units.en: After the King of Han reached Nanzheng, the generals and soldiers all sang songs longing to return east, and many deserted along the roads.
units.literal: King Han having arrived at Nanzheng, the generals and soldiers all sang ballads longing to return east, and many deserted and went back by the roads.

units.zh: 韓信為治粟都尉，亦亡去，蕭何追還之，因薦於漢王，曰：「
units.en: Han Xin was Commandant for Grain Supply, but he too deserted. Xiao He pursued him, brought him back, and then recommended him to the King of Han, saying: "
units.literal: Han Xin was grain supply commander, but he also deserted. Xiao He pursued and brought him back, then recommended him to King Han, saying: "

units.zh: 於是漢王齊戒設壇場，拜信為大將軍，問以計策。
units.en: So King Han purified himself and set up an altar platform, appointing Xin as grand general and asking him for strategies.
units.literal: So King Han purified himself and set up an altar platform, appointing Xin as grand general and asking him for strategies.

units.zh: 漢王大說，遂聽信策，部署諸將。
units.en: King Han was greatly pleased and followed Xin's strategy, deploying the various generals.
units.literal: King Han was greatly pleased and followed Xin's strategy, deploying the various generals.

units.zh: 漢王遂定雍地。
units.en: King Han then pacified Yong territory.
units.literal: King Han then pacified Yong territory.

units.zh: 羽以良從漢王，韓王成又無功，故不遣就國，與俱至彭城，殺之。
units.en: Because Zhang Liang had accompanied the King of Han (Liu Bang), and King Cheng of Han had achieved nothing, Xiang Yu would not let Cheng go to his kingdom; he brought Cheng to Pengcheng and killed him.
units.literal: Xiang Yu, because Liang followed King Han, and King Han Cheng had no merit, did not send him to his kingdom but brought him to Pengcheng and killed him.

units.zh: 及聞漢王并關中，而齊、梁畔之，羽大怒，乃以故吳令鄭昌為韓王，距漢。
units.en: When Xiang Yu heard that the King of Han had taken all of Guanzhong and that Qi and Liang had rebelled against him, he was furious. He made Zheng Chang, the former magistrate of Wu, King of Han to block Han.
units.literal: When he heard that King Han had united Guanzhong and Qi and Liang had rebelled, Xiang Yu was greatly angered. He established the former Wu magistrate Zheng Chang as King of Han to oppose Han.

units.zh: 九月，漢王遣將軍薛歐、王吸出武關，因王陵兵，從南陽迎太公、呂后於沛。
units.en: In the ninth month, the King of Han sent Generals Xue Ou and Wang Xi out through Wuguan to join Wang Ling's troops and proceed from Nanyang to Pei to escort the Venerable Sire and Empress Lü.
units.literal: In the ninth month, King Han sent generals Xue Ou and Wang Xi out of Wuguan, relying on Wang Ling's troops, going from Nanyang to welcome the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü from Pei.

units.zh: 耳敗走降漢，漢王厚遇之。
units.en: Zhang Er was defeated, fled, and surrendered to Han. King Han treated him generously.
units.literal: Zhang Er was defeated, fled, and surrendered to Han. King Han treated him generously.

units.zh: 張良自韓間行歸漢，漢王以為成信侯。
units.en: Zhang Liang stole his way back from Han to join the King of Han. The King of Han made him Lord Chengxin.
units.literal: Zhang Liang secretly made his way back to Han from Korea. King Han enfeoffed him as Lord Chengxin.

units.zh: 漢王如陝，鎮撫關外父老。
units.en: King Han went to Shan and pacified the elders outside the passes.
units.literal: King Han went to Shan and pacified the elders outside the passes.

units.zh: 漢王還歸，都櫟陽，使諸將略地，拔隴西。
units.en: King Han returned and established his capital at Queyang, sending various generals to seize territory and capture Longxi.
units.literal: King Han returned and established his capital at Queyang, sending various generals to seize territory and capture Longxi.

units.zh: 漢王與語，說之，使參乘，監諸將。
units.en: King Han spoke with him and was pleased. He had him ride in the chariot and oversee the various generals.
units.literal: King Han spoke with him and was pleased. He had him ride in the chariot and oversee the various generals.

units.zh: 於是漢王為義帝發喪，袒而大哭，哀臨三日。
units.en: So King Han held mourning rites for the Righteous Emperor, bared his shoulder and wept loudly, conducting the mourning rites for three days.
units.literal: So King Han held mourning rites for the Righteous Emperor, bared his shoulder and wept loudly, conducting the mourning rites for three days.

units.zh: 羽雖聞漢東，既擊齊，欲遂破之而後擊漢，漢王以故得劫五諸侯兵，東伐楚。
units.en: Although Xiang Yu heard that Han was advancing east, he was already attacking Qi and wanted to crush it completely before turning against Han. The King of Han was therefore able to take command of the five feudal lords' troops and advance east to attack Chu.
units.literal: Although Xiang Yu heard that Han was advancing east, since he was attacking Qi, he wished to completely defeat Qi first and then attack Han. King Han therefore was able to coerce the five feudal lords' troops and advance east to attack Chu.

units.zh: 漢王拜越為魏相國，令定梁地。
units.en: King Han appointed Yue as prime minister of Wei and ordered him to pacify Liang territory.
units.literal: King Han appointed Yue as prime minister of Wei and ordered him to pacify Liang territory.

units.zh: 漢王遂入彭城，收羽美人貨賂，置酒高會。
units.en: King Han then entered Pengcheng, took Xiang Yu's beautiful women and treasures, and held a great banquet.
units.literal: King Han then entered Pengcheng, took Xiang Yu's beautiful women and treasures, and held a great banquet.

units.zh: 圍漢王三匝。
units.en: He surrounded King Han three times.
units.literal: He surrounded King Han three times.

units.zh: 大風從西北起，折木發屋，揚砂石，晝晦，楚軍大亂，而漢王得與數十騎遁去。
units.en: A great wind rose from the northwest, snapping trees, tearing roofs from houses, and whipping up sand and stones until daylight turned dark. The Chu army was thrown into chaos, and the King of Han escaped with several dozen riders.
units.literal: A great wind arose from the northwest, breaking trees and tearing off roofs, whipping up sand and stones, darkening the day. The Chu army was greatly thrown into confusion, and King Han was able to escape with several dozen cavalry.

units.zh: 漢王道逢孝惠、魯元，載行。
units.en: King Han met Xiaohui and Lu Yuan on the road and had them ride in the carriage.
units.literal: King Han met Xiaohui and Lu Yuan on the road and had them ride in the carriage.

units.zh: 楚騎追漢王，漢王急，推墮二子。
units.en: Chu cavalry pursued King Han. King Han was desperate and pushed the two children off the carriage.
units.literal: Chu cavalry pursued King Han. King Han was desperate and pushed the two children off the carriage.

units.zh: 呂后兄周呂侯將兵居下邑，漢王往從之。
units.en: Empress Lü's elder brother Zhou Lühou led troops stationed at Xiayi. King Han went to join him.
units.literal: Empress Lü's elder brother Zhou Lühou led troops stationed at Xiayi. King Han went to join him.

units.zh: 漢王西過梁地，至虞，謂謁者隨何曰：「公能說九江王布使舉兵畔楚，項王必留擊之。
units.en: The King of Han passed west through Liang territory and reached Yu. He said to the usher Sui He: "Can you persuade Ying Bu, King of Jiujiang, to raise troops and rebel against Chu? Xiang Yu will certainly stay behind to attack him.
units.literal: King Han passed west through Liang territory and reached Yu. He said to the usher Sui He: "You can persuade King Jiujiang Ying Bu to raise troops and rebel against Chu. Xiang Yu will certainly stay to attack him.

units.zh: 五月，漢王屯滎陽，蕭何發關中老弱未傅者悉詣軍。
units.en: In the fifth month, the King of Han encamped at Xingyang. Xiao He called up all the old and weak men in Guanzhong who had not yet been registered for service and sent them to the army.
units.literal: In the fifth month, King Han encamped at Xingyang. Xiao He conscripted all the old and weak in Guanzhong who had not yet been registered and sent them all to the army.

units.zh: 韓信亦收兵與漢王會，兵復大振。
units.en: Han Xin also gathered troops and joined King Han. The army was greatly strengthened again.
units.literal: Han Xin also gathered troops and joined King Han. The army was greatly strengthened again.

units.zh: 六月，漢王還櫟陽。
units.en: In the sixth month, King Han returned to Queyang.
units.literal: In the sixth month, King Han returned to Queyang.

units.zh: 秋八月，漢王如滎陽，謂酈食其曰：「緩頰往說魏王豹，能下之，以魏地萬戶封生。」
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn, the King of Han went to Xingyang and said to Li Yiji: "Go and talk Wei Bao into submission with your eloquence. If you can bring him down, I will enfeoff you with ten thousand households from Wei territory."
units.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, King Han went to Xingyang and said to Li Yiji: "Go slowly to persuade King Wei Bao. If you can make him submit, I will enfeoff you with 10,000 households from Wei territory."

units.zh: 漢王以韓信為左丞相，與曹參、灌嬰俱擊魏。
units.en: King Han appointed Han Xin as left chancellor, and together with Cao Shen and Guan Ying attacked Wei.
units.literal: King Han appointed Han Xin as left chancellor, and together with Cao Shen and Guan Ying attacked Wei.

units.zh: 食其還，漢王問：「魏大將誰也？」
units.en: Li Yiji returned. King Han asked: "Who is Wei's chief general?"
units.literal: Li Yiji returned. King Han asked: "Who is Wei's chief general?"

units.zh: 漢王與之。
units.en: King Han agreed.
units.literal: King Han agreed.

units.zh: 漢王分之兵，與俱收兵至成皋。
units.en: King Han divided his troops with them and together gathered troops to reach Chenggao.
units.literal: King Han divided his troops with them and together gathered troops to reach Chenggao.

units.zh: 食其欲立六國後以樹黨，漢王刻印，將遣食其立之。
units.en: Li Yiji wanted to establish descendants of the six kingdoms in order to build a bloc of allies. The King of Han had seals carved and was about to send Li Yiji to install them.
units.literal: Li Yiji wished to establish the descendants of the six kingdoms to create allies. King Han carved seals and was about to send Li Yiji to establish them.

units.zh: 漢王輟飯吐哺，曰：「豎儒幾敗乃公事！」
units.en: The King of Han put down his food and spat it out, saying: "You pedant! You nearly ruined my whole plan!"
units.literal: King Han put down his food and spat it out, saying: "This pedantic scholar almost ruined your lord's affairs!"

units.zh: 夏四月，項羽圍漢滎陽，漢王請和，割滎陽以西者為漢。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, Xiang Yu surrounded Han at Xingyang. King Han requested peace, offering to divide Xingyang west as Han territory.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Xiang Yu surrounded Han at Xingyang. King Han requested peace, offering to divide Xingyang west as Han territory.

units.zh: 亞父勸項羽急攻滎陽，漢王患之。
units.en: Prime Minister Fan advised Xiang Yu to urgently attack Xingyang. King Han was troubled by this.
units.literal: Prime Minister Fan advised Xiang Yu to urgently attack Xingyang. King Han was troubled by this.

units.zh: 紀信乃乘王車，黃屋左纛，曰：「食盡，漢王降楚。」
units.en: Ji Xin then rode in the king's chariot with yellow canopy and left banner, saying: "Food is exhausted. King Han surrenders to Chu."
units.literal: Ji Xin then rode in the king's chariot with yellow canopy and left banner, saying: "Food is exhausted. King Han surrenders to Chu."

units.zh: 楚皆呼萬歲，之城東觀，以故漢王得與數十騎出西門遁。
units.en: All the Chu troops shouted, "Ten thousand years!" and went to the eastern side of the city to watch. Because of this, the King of Han escaped through the west gate with several dozen riders.
units.literal: All the Chu troops shouted ten thousand years. They went to the east wall to watch, so King Han was able to escape with several dozen cavalry through the west gate.

units.zh: 轅生說漢王曰：「漢與楚相距滎陽數歲，漢常困。
units.en: Guan Sheng advised King Han: "Han and Chu have confronted each other at Xingyang for several years. Han has often been in difficulty.
units.literal: Guan Sheng advised King Han: "Han and Chu have confronted each other at Xingyang for several years. Han has often been in difficulty.

units.zh: 願君王出武關，項王必引兵南走，王深壁，令滎陽成皋間且得休息。
units.en: I ask Your Majesty to go out through Wuguan. Xiang Yu will certainly lead his troops south. Your Majesty should hold deep behind fortifications and let the area between Xingyang and Chenggao gain some respite.
units.literal: I hope your majesty will go out through Wuguan. Xiang Yu will certainly lead troops south. Your majesty should fortify deeply and let the area between Xingyang and Chenggao get some rest.

units.zh: 使韓信等得輯河北趙地，連燕齊，君王乃復走滎陽。
units.en: Let Han Xin and the others consolidate Zhao territory north of the Yellow River and link up with Yan and Qi. Your Majesty can then return to Xingyang.
units.literal: Let Han Xin and others consolidate the lands north of the Yellow River in Zhao, connecting Yan and Qi. Your majesty can then return to Xingyang.

units.zh: 漢王從其計，出軍宛葉間，與黥布行收兵。
units.en: King Han followed his plan, led troops out between Wan and Ye, and together with Ying Bu went to gather troops.
units.literal: King Han followed his plan, led troops out between Wan and Ye, and together with Ying Bu went to gather troops.

units.zh: 羽聞漢王在宛，果引兵南，漢王堅壁不與戰。
units.en: Xiang Yu heard that King Han was at Wan and indeed led troops south. King Han fortified deeply and did not fight him.
units.literal: Xiang Yu heard that King Han was at Wan and indeed led troops south. King Han fortified deeply and did not fight him.

units.zh: 漢王引兵北，擊破終公，復軍成皋。
units.en: King Han led troops north, attacked and defeated Zhong Gong, and returned his army to Chenggao.
units.literal: King Han led troops north, attacked and defeated Zhong Gong, and returned his army to Chenggao.

units.zh: 若非漢王敵也。」
units.en: You are no match for King Han."
units.literal: You are no match for King Han."

units.zh: 漢王跳，獨與滕公共車出成皋玉門，北渡河，宿小脩武。
units.en: The King of Han escaped suddenly, sharing a chariot only with Lord Teng as he left Chenggao by the Jade Gate. They crossed the Yellow River northward and spent the night at Xiao Xiuwu.
units.literal: King Han leapt away, alone with Lord Teng sharing a chariot out of Chenggao's Jade Gate. They crossed north over the Yellow River and stayed at Xiao Xiuwu.

units.zh: 漢王得韓信軍，復大振。
units.en: King Han got Han Xin's army and was greatly strengthened again.
units.literal: King Han got Han Xin's army and was greatly strengthened again.

units.zh: 郎中鄭忠說止漢王，高壘深塹勿戰。
units.en: Attendant Zheng Zhong advised King Han to stop, building high fortifications and deep moats without fighting.
units.literal: Attendant Zheng Zhong advised King Han to stop, building high fortifications and deep moats without fighting.

units.zh: 漢王聽其計，使盧綰、劉賈將卒二萬人，騎數百，渡白馬津入楚地，佐彭越燒楚積聚，復擊破楚軍燕郭西，攻下睢陽、外黃十七城。
units.en: The King of Han followed his plan, sending Lu Wan and Liu Jia with twenty thousand soldiers and several hundred riders across Baima Ford into Chu territory. They assisted Peng Yue in burning Chu's stockpiles, then attacked and defeated the Chu army west of Yanguo, capturing seventeen cities, including Suiyang and Waihuang.
units.literal: King Han followed his plan, sending Lu Wan and Liu Jia with 20,000 troops and several hundred cavalry across Baima ford into Chu territory. They assisted Peng Yue in burning Chu's grain stores, then attacked and broke the Chu army west of Yan Guo, capturing Suiyang and Waihuang, 17 cities.

units.zh: 即漢王欲挑戰，慎勿與戰，勿令得東而已。
units.en: If King Han wants to provoke battle, be careful not to fight him. Just do not let him get east.
units.literal: If King Han wants to provoke battle, be careful not to fight him. Just do not let him get east.

units.zh: 漢王使酈食其說齊王田廣，罷守兵與漢和。
units.en: King Han sent Li Yiji to persuade King Qi Tian Guang to dismiss his guarding troops and make peace with Han.
units.literal: King Han sent Li Yiji to persuade King Qi Tian Guang to dismiss his guarding troops and make peace with Han.

units.zh: 漢王引兵渡河，復取成皋，軍廣武，就敖倉食。
units.en: King Han led troops across the river, recaptured Chenggao, and encamped at Guangwu, drawing provisions from Aocang.
units.literal: King Han led troops across the river, recaptured Chenggao, and encamped at Guangwu, drawing provisions from Aocang.

units.zh: 漢王、羽相與臨廣武之間而語。
units.en: King Han and Xiang Yu faced each other across Guangwu and spoke.
units.literal: King Han and Xiang Yu faced each other across Guangwu and spoke.

units.zh: 羽欲與漢王獨身挑戰，漢王數羽曰：「吾始與羽俱受命懷王，曰先定關中者王之。
units.en: Xiang Yu wanted to challenge the King of Han to single combat. The King of Han instead listed Xiang Yu's crimes: "At first, Xiang Yu and I both received King Huai's command, which said that whoever first pacified Guanzhong would be made king there.
units.literal: Xiang Yu wanted to challenge King Han to single combat. King Han listed Xiang Yu's crimes: "I and Xiang Yu both received commands from King Huai, saying whoever first pacified Guanzhong would be made king.

units.zh: 羽大怒，伏弩射中漢王。
units.en: Xiang Yu was greatly angered and had a crossbow shoot King Han.
units.literal: Xiang Yu was greatly angered and had a crossbow shoot King Han.

units.zh: 漢王傷胸，乃捫足曰：「虜中吾指！」
units.en: King Han was wounded in the chest, but he patted his foot and said: "The bandit hit my toe!"
units.literal: King Han was wounded in the chest, but he patted his foot and said: "The bandit hit my toe!"

units.zh: 漢王病創臥，張良彊請漢王起行勞軍，以安士卒，毋令楚乘勝。
units.en: The King of Han lay ill from his wound. Zhang Liang strongly urged him to get up and go comfort the army, in order to steady the officers and soldiers and not let Chu exploit its victory.
units.literal: King Han lay ill from his wound. Zhang Liang strongly urged King Han to rise and go encourage the troops to stabilize the soldiers and officers, not letting Chu take advantage of their victory.

units.zh: 漢王出行軍，疾甚，因馳入成皋。
units.en: King Han went out to encourage the troops, but his illness was severe, so he galloped into Chenggao.
units.literal: King Han went out to encourage the troops, but his illness was severe, so he galloped into Chenggao.

units.zh: 漢王疾瘉，西入關，至櫟陽，存問父老，置酒。
units.en: King Han recovered from his illness, entered the passes to the west, reached Queyang, visited the elders, and held a banquet.
units.literal: King Han recovered from his illness, entered the passes to the west, reached Queyang, visited the elders, and held a banquet.

units.zh: 漢王怒，欲攻之。
units.en: King Han was angry and wanted to attack him.
units.literal: King Han was angry and wanted to attack him.

units.zh: 漢王下令：軍士不幸死者，吏為衣衾棺斂，轉送其家。
units.en: King Han issued an order: For soldiers who unfortunately die, officials shall provide burial clothes, coffins, and shrouds, and transport them home.
units.literal: King Han issued an order: For soldiers who unfortunately die, officials shall provide burial clothes, coffins, and shrouds, and transport them home.

units.zh: 漢王欲西歸，張良、陳平諫曰：「今漢有天下太半，而諸侯皆附，楚兵罷食盡，此天亡之時，不因其幾而遂取之，所謂養虎自遺患也。」
units.en: The King of Han wanted to return west. Zhang Liang and Chen Ping advised him: "Han now possesses more than half the realm, and all the feudal lords have attached themselves to it. Chu's troops are exhausted and its food is gone. This is the moment when Heaven is destroying Chu. If we do not seize this opportunity and take it, that is what is called raising a tiger and leaving disaster for oneself."
units.literal: King Han wanted to return west. Zhang Liang and Chen Ping advised: "Now Han possesses more than half the world, and all the feudal lords are attached. Chu troops are exhausted and food is finished. This is the time Heaven has doomed them. If we do not take advantage of this opportunity to destroy them, this is called raising a tiger that brings disaster to oneself."

units.zh: 昔陳平背楚，歸漢則強，百里出虞，入秦斯霸。
units.en: Formerly Chen Ping turned from Chu; returning to Han he became strong. Baili left Yu; entering Qin he became hegemon.
units.literal: Formerly Chen Ping turned from Chu; returning to Han he became strong. Baili left Yu; entering Qin he became hegemon.

units.zh: 事富《山海》，郭璞注而未詳。
units.en: matters rich as the Classic of Mountains and Seas—Guo Pu annotated them yet could not exhaust them.
units.literal: matters rich as the Classic of Mountains and Seas—Guo Pu annotated yet could not exhaust them.

units.zh: 久之，王問仲舒曰：「粵王勾踐與大夫洩庸、種、蠡謀伐吳，遂滅之。
units.en: One day the king asked, "Goujian of Yue and his ministers Xie Yong, Wen Zhong, and Fan Li destroyed Wu by counsel.
units.literal: After a long time the king asked Zhongshu, saying: "The Yue king Goujian, with his great officers Xie Yong, Zhong, and Li, plotted to attack Wu and thereby destroyed it.
